ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Spooler Service Suspicious Binary Load
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect DLL Load from Spooler Service backup folder Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\spoolsv\\\.exe$") AND (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\drivers\\\\x64\\\\3\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\drivers\\\\x64\\\\4\\\\.*")) AND ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\.dll$"))
